Config Provider

Source: vignettes/articles/components/config-provider.Rmd
config-provider.Rmd

Config Provider is used for providing global configurations, which enables your entire application to access these configurations everywhere.

i18n Configurations

Configure i18n related properties via Config Provider, to get language switching feature.

Use two attributes to provide i18n related config

The button switches the language of what is inside the provider, with update_el_config_provider(locale =): the table’s empty text, the pagination’s words. The page’s own language is el_page(locale =).

ui <- el_page(
  el_button("toggle", "Switch Language"),
  tags$br(),
  el_config_provider(
    id = "cfg",
    locale = "zh-cn",
    el_table(data = data.frame(date = character(), name = character())),
    el_pagination("cfg_pg", total = 100, layout = "total, prev, pager, next")
  )
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  language <- reactiveVal("zh-cn")
  observeEvent(input$toggle, {
    language(if (language() == "zh-cn") "en" else "zh-cn")
    update_el_config_provider(session, "cfg", locale = language())
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)

Button Configurations

The checkboxes and the select are a store’s fields, [v_model()]; the provider’s button settings a getter of the store built from them, [v_bind()], which the button inside takes as its defaults – all in the browser.

vue_store(
  "cfg_button",
  state = list(
    autoInsertSpace = TRUE,
    type = "default",
    plain = TRUE,
    round = TRUE,
    text = FALSE,
    dashed = FALSE
  ),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return Object.assign({}, s); }"))
)
tags$div(
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_space",
    "autoInsertSpace",
    value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_button.autoInsertSpace")
  ),
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_plain",
    "plain",
    value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_button.plain")
  ),
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_round",
    "round",
    value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_button.round")
  ),
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_dashed",
    "dashed",
    value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_button.dashed")
  ),
  el_checkbox("cfg_text", "text", value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_button.text")),
  el_select(
    "cfg_type",
    choices = c("primary", "success", "warning", "danger", "info", "default"),
    selected = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_button.type"),
    width = "150px"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  button = v_bind("$vueStore.cfg_button.config"),
  el_button("cfg_btn", "中文")
)

Link Configurations

The selects set the provider’s link settings through a store’s getter, which the link inside takes as its defaults.

vue_store(
  "cfg_links",
  state = list(type = "success", underline = "always"),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return Object.assign({}, s); }"))
)
tags$div(
  style = "display: flex; gap: 16px",
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; flex-basis: 150px",
    tags$span("Type:"),
    el_select(
      "cfg_type",
      choices = c("primary", "success", "warning", "info", "danger", "default"),
      selected = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_links.type")
    )
  ),
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; flex-basis: 150px",
    tags$span("Underline:"),
    el_select(
      "cfg_underline",
      choices = c("always", "never", "hover"),
      selected = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_links.underline")
    )
  )
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  link = v_bind("$vueStore.cfg_links.config"),
  el_link("Link desu!", id = "cfg_link")
)

Card Configurations

The radios set the provider’s card settings through a store’s getter; a card inside takes them when it sets no shadow of its own.

vue_store(
  "cfg_card",
  state = list(shadow = "always"),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return { shadow: s.shadow }; }"))
)
tags$span("Shadow:")
el_radio_group(
  "cfg_shadow",
  choices = c("always", "hover", "never"),
  value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_card.shadow")
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  card = v_bind("$vueStore.cfg_card.config"),
  el_card("Card desu!")
)
Shadow:

Dialog Configurations

The switches set the provider’s dialog settings through a store’s getter, which the dialog inside takes as its defaults; overflow is off while the dialog cannot be dragged. Element’s transition setting is not taken: the dialog is markup and plays Element’s own dialog-fade.

vue_store(
  "cfg_dialog",
  state = list(
    alignCenter = FALSE,
    draggable = FALSE,
    overflow = FALSE,
    open = FALSE
  ),
  getters = list(
    config = JS(
      "function(s) { return { alignCenter: s.alignCenter, draggable: s.draggable, overflow: s.overflow }; }"
    ),
    fixed = JS("function(s) { return !s.draggable; }")
  )
)
tags$div(
  style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px",
  el_switch(
    "cfg_align",
    value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_dialog.alignCenter"),
    active_text = "alignCenter"
  ),
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; gap: 16px",
    el_switch(
      "cfg_drag",
      value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_dialog.draggable"),
      active_text = "draggable"
    ),
    el_switch(
      "cfg_overflow",
      value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_dialog.overflow"),
      active_text = "overflow",
      disabled = v_bind("$vueStore.cfg_dialog.fixed")
    )
  ),
  tags$div(
    el_button(
      "cfg_open",
      "Open Dialog",
      type = "primary",
      size = "small",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.cfg_dialog.open = true")
    )
  )
)
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  dialog = v_bind("$vueStore.cfg_dialog.config"),
  el_dialog(
    "cfg_dlg",
    title = "Dialog Title",
    destroy_on_close = TRUE,
    visible = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_dialog.open"),
    content = "Dialog Content"
  )
)

Message Configurations

The provider’s message settings are Element Plus’s page-wide message defaults, so they reach every message on the page – $message() in the browser, el_message() from the server: at most three at a time, plain, at the bottom.

el_config_provider(
  message = list(max = 3, plain = TRUE, placement = "bottom"),
  el_button(
    "cfg_msg",
    "OPEN",
    on = list(click = "$message('This is a message from bottom.')")
  )
)

Empty Values Configurations

Supported components list
  • Cascader
  • ColorPicker 2.10.3
  • DatePicker
  • Select
  • SelectV2
  • TimePicker
  • TimeSelect
  • TreeSelect

Set empty-values to support empty values of components. The fallback value is ['', null, undefined]. If you think the empty string is meaningful, write [undefined, null].

Set value-on-clear to set the return value when cleared. The fallback value is undefined. In the date component is null. If you want to set undefined, use () => undefined.

el_config_provider(
  value_on_clear = NULL,
  empty_values = list(NULL),
  el_select(
    "cfg_sel",
    choices = c("Option1", "Option2", "Option3"),
    clearable = TRUE,
    placeholder = "Select",
    width = "240px"
  )
)

Table Configurations

The checkbox and the select set the provider’s table settings through a store’s getter: a column that sets no show_overflow_tooltip of its own takes them.

vue_store(
  "cfg_table",
  state = list(showOverflowTooltip = TRUE, tooltipEffect = "dark"),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return Object.assign({}, s); }"))
)
tags$div(
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_tip",
    "showOverflowTooltip",
    value = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_table.showOverflowTooltip")
  ),
  el_select(
    "cfg_effect",
    choices = c(dark = "dark", light = "light"),
    selected = v_model("$vueStore.cfg_table.tooltipEffect"),
    width = "150px"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  table = v_bind("$vueStore.cfg_table.config"),
  el_table(
    data = data.frame(
      date = c("2016-05-03", "2016-05-02", "2016-05-04"),
      name = "Tom",
      address = "No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles, a long address for the cell"
    ),
    selection = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      el_table_column("date", "Date", width = 120),
      el_table_column("name", "Name", width = 120),
      el_table_column(
        "address",
        "Address (inherited from config-provider)",
        width = 300
      ),
      el_table_column(
        "address",
        "Address (explicit false)",
        show_overflow_tooltip = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
)

Experimental features

In this section, you can learn how to use Config Provider to provide experimental features. For now, we haven’t added any experimental features, but in the feature roadmap, we will add some experimental features. You can use this config to manage the features you want or not.

API

Element Plus’s tables, and beside each entry where it is in R.

Config Provider Attributes

Element In R Description Type Accepted Default
locale el_page(locale =) Locale Object 1{name: string, el: TranslatePair} languages en
size size global component size 2'large' \\| 'default' \\| 'small' default
zIndex el_page(z_index =) global Initial zIndex 3 —
namespace (fixed:el) global component className prefix (cooperated with $namespace) 4 el
button button button related configuration, see the following table 5{autoInsertSpace?: boolean, type?: string, plain?: boolean, text?: boolean, round?: boolean, dashed?: boolean} see the following table
link link link related configuration, see the following table 6{type?: string, underline?: boolean \\| string} see the following table
dialog dialog dialog related configuration, see the following table 7{alignCenter?: boolean, draggable?: boolean, overflow?: boolean, transition?: DialogTransition} see the following table
message message message related configuration, see the following table 8{max?: number} see the following table
experimental-features experimental_features features at experimental stage to be added, all features are default to be set to false 9 —
empty-values empty_values global empty values of components 10 —
value-on-clear value_on_clear global clear return value 11 / 12 / 13 / 14 —
table table table related configuration, see the following table 15{showOverflowTooltip?: boolean \\| object, tooltipEffect?: string, tooltipOptions?: object, tooltipFormatter?: Function} see the following table
